excerpts.text: Update: Aug 2, 2012: Not knowing of an alternative fish market option in Chelsea, I thought I'd give Lobster Place another chance. I bought two pounds of wild shrimp and put it on ice. … They have seafood in every way you can imagine - fish to take home, 3-pound lobsters, lobster rolls, a sushi bar, frozen items, condiments to go with the seafood to take home to cook that you will want to spend all of your money on, oysters shucked right in front of you, you name it! …

In the heart of Chelsea market there is the lobster place, for all lovers of raw and shellfish it is the ideal place! Great butter sandwich with lobster, but the experience is absolutely to take a lobster just cooked put the gloves and eat it still hot on the tables inside the structure.
